name: BRCA1 DNA repair associated

function.text: BRCA1 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that coordinates the DNA-damage response and homologous-recombination repair, including functions performed with BARD1 and other repair factors.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to BRCA1-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia, complementation group S (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Pancreatic acinar cell carcinoma; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; High-grade serous carcinoma, tubo-ovarian / peritoneal. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: BRCA1 encodes a tumor-suppressor protein that coordinates the DNA-damage response and homologous-recombination repair, including functions performed with BARD1 and other repair factors.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with BRCA1-related cancer predisposition (autosomal dominant); Fanconi anemia, complementation group S (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving BRCA1 have been reported in high-grade serous carcinoma, tubo-ovarian / peritoneal, invasive breast carcinoma, and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
